hook: They screen the big. Free dunk.
lines: Spain. The 1 up top, the 5 at the nail, the 2 tucked behind.
The 5 sets the ball screen. His man drops into the lane.
Now the 2 back-screens that dropping big.
The 1 drives right, and the 5 rolls down the middle.
The big is trailing the roll. Lob it over him.
Dunk. The big is three feet behind.
Facing a drop big? Screen him, then roll to the rim.
